prose: Laminar (YC S24) launches its open-source observability platform for AI agents, built since 2024, and headlines flow-1: a model trained with reinforcement learning to find errors in agent traces. On Laminar's benchmark, flow-1 matches GPT-6-sol in detection quality while being 23x cheaper - cheap enough, the founders argue, to analyze every production agent trace instead of sampling. The launch post walks through example traces and analyses, positioning trace review by a dedicated small model as the scalable answer to agent monitoring.
highlights: Laminar (YC S24): open-source observability for AI agents, built since 2024
flow-1: RL-trained model that finds errors in agent traces
Claims GPT-6-sol-level detection quality at 23x lower cost
Cheap enough to analyze every production trace, no sampling
Launch includes a walkthrough video and example trace analyses
